purpose: Start a clean external-only OneCore v2 joint-training lineage from random initialization. Reuse the already validated, unchanged five-family corpus artifact onecore-corpus-final from workflow run 44925751665; do not re-acquire, download, re-package, or repeat the successful data gate. Run ten sequential 150-step sessions (1,500 cumulative optimizer updates), each update sampling one external micro-batch from each of text/tool/image/audio/video. Then perform actual independent validation and held-out test, recording checkpoint/tokenizer/manifest hashes. Keep promotion blocked unless the approved quality gate passes. This is only the first 1,500-update segment (7.5% of the configured 20,000-step schedule), not training completion.
